channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels earns Tampa Bay Buccaneers backup QB role
item.description: Jalon Daniels entered training camp fourth on the depth chart but outperformed veteran Jake Browning to earn the backup quarterback role.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: city council] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Clearwater group surpasses signature threshold to challenge City Council's South Garden Avenue decision
item.description: Save the Garden has collected over 7,300 signatures — surpassing the 7,067 required — to trigger a review of City Council's vote to vacate part of South Garden Avenue.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Looking to smell like Mountain Dew? How about trying their new body wash and soap.
item.description: Have you ever wished you could smell like Mountain Dew? Well now you're in luck. The popular soda has partnered with Duke Cannon for a body wash and soap.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] DHS memo shows Trump administration explored using National Guard in immigration enforcement
item.description: A newly revealed DHS memo shows the Trump administration explored using National Guard troops as immigration officers. Legal experts say the theory has never been tested in court. What do you think?

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Billy Adams found guilty of first-degree murder in death of a mother and unborn child
item.description: A Tampa rapper was found guilty Tuesday of first-degree murder for killing a pregnant mother more than three years ago.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] DEA tactic that let fentanyl flood the streets is being investigated by House Republicans
item.description: A controversial policing tactic that permitted staggering amounts of fentanyl to reach the streets as federal authorities sought to build bigger drug cases is now under investigation by Republicans.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs' recalled due to undeclared milk allergens
item.description: If you're already looking into purchasing treats for Halloween, be aware! Crystal Temptations has recalled their "Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs" due to undeclared milk allergens.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] House votes to keep government funded through midterm elections
item.description: The House voted Tuesday to extend government funding until after the November midterm elections, averting a shutdown that would have begun if lawmakers failed to approve funding by Sept. 30.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Thieves steal $70,000 in Pabst beer from California warehouse
item.description: Police in Southern California are investigating the theft of more than 30,000 cans of Pabst beer in two separate heists from the same warehouse on the same day.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Massachusetts Democratic primary is a generational clash as Rep. Seth Moulton targets Sen. Ed Markey
item.description: Massachusetts Democrats head to the polls Tuesday in a Senate primary that could reshape the party's future. Will generational change win out? 🗳️

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa rapper Billy Adams found guilty in murder of pregnant girlfriend
item.description: Tampa rapper Billy Adams was found guilty Tuesday in the 2023 murder of his pregnant girlfriend.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: city council] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] South Howard flood relief project faces pivotal Tampa City Council vote
item.description: A controversial flood relief project in Tampa's South Howard neighborhood is heading toward a key vote this week, with city officials arguing the work is needed to protect hundreds of homes while business owners warn the construction could threaten their livelihoods.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Man warns of sophisticated scam after caller poses as Pinellas County Sheriff's Office
item.description: A Pinellas County man is warning the public after nearly falling victim to a complex phone scheme involving fake warrants and demands for wired cash.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Nathan Benderson Park to host 9/11 memorial stair climb
item.description: Firefighters, emergency crews and community members are preparing to gather at Nathan Benderson Park in Sarasota for a memorial stair climb honoring those who lost their lives on Sept. 11, 2001.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Sarasota police report 70% drop in school zone speeding after implementing safety program
item.description: Sarasota police reported a major drop in school zone speeding violations after implementing safety enforcement cameras across the city.
